items.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Robotics 2 can control a humanoid robot's entire body
items.excerpt: Google DeepMind announced Gemini Robotics 2, a model that adds intelligent whole-body control so a humanoid robot can coordinate its arms, torso and base together -- tying up trash bags, unscrewing lightbulbs and handling multi-step chores. A concrete step toward general-purpose embodied AI in consumer-facing home robots.

items.title: OpenAI's first device is a screenless, movable AI companion speaker -- with a smartphone to follow
items.excerpt: OpenAI's hardware roadmap has sharpened: its first product is a portable, screenless smart speaker built with former Apple design chief Jony Ive as an at-home AI companion, with a camera to understand its surroundings and a smartphone reportedly arriving as soon as next year. A design-led rethink of what an AI-native home device looks like.

items.title: That Friend AI wearable you don't like just got worse
items.excerpt: The new Friend pendant adds a speaker and updated models but doubles down on the same off-putting always-listening AI-companion premise. A pointed look at how a physical AI wearable's interaction design -- not just its models -- shapes whether people actually want to live with it.

items.title: DJI Osmo Pocket 4P review: the gimbal camera goes pro with dual lenses
items.excerpt: DJI's pocket gimbal camera goes 'pro' with two lenses, optical zoom, class-leading dynamic range and AI subject tracking. A creator-focused standalone AI camera that reshapes how solo shooters capture and follow subjects on the move.

items.title: Sonos schedules a September product event -- and it's likely about AI
items.excerpt: Sonos has set a September event that's expected to center on AI, signaling the audio maker's push to fold generative and assistant AI into its speakers and home-audio hardware. An early read on how ambient home-audio devices get reframed around AI.

items.title: Exploring Apple Silicon's local AI performance with the Mac Studio and M4 Max
items.excerpt: A hands-on benchmark of on-device LLM performance across Apple's M4 Max, NVIDIA's GB10 and AMD Strix Halo, finding the M4 Max leads on decode throughput while memory bandwidth alone doesn't decide the winner. A concrete look at which consumer hardware actually runs local AI well for creative and dev workloads.

items.title: Halliday G2: camera-free smart glasses bring heads-up meeting AI
items.excerpt: The Halliday G2 skips the camera and instead leans on binocular micro-LED displays and a 'Meeting Flow' AI that delivers live translation, captioning, research lookups and post-meeting transcripts in a sub-50g frame. A privacy-forward take on how AI eyewear can assist without recording everyone around you.

items.title: Snap sets a September event to launch its consumer AR Specs
items.excerpt: Snap has scheduled a September event to launch its standalone consumer AR Specs, its bid to bring AI-powered spatial computing to a mainstream wearable. A signal of how the AR-glasses race is heating up beyond Meta and Google as a new AI-first consumer form factor.

items.title: Insta360's CEO on 'robot vision': where the camera maker's AI is heading
items.excerpt: Insta360's founder discusses making the company's cameras more intelligent and autonomous through 'robot vision,' while insisting human experience and creativity stay central to the shooting process. A look at how AI is reshaping the craft of computational and autonomous photography gear.
